raw_meta_yaml:
schema_version: 1

context:
  name: "plumed"
  version: "2.10.1"
  mpi_prefix: ${{ "nompi" if mpi == "nompi" else "mpi_" + mpi }}

package:
  name: ${{ name }}
  version: ${{ version }}

source:
  url: https://github.com/${{ name }}/${{ name }}2/archive/v${{ version }}.tar.gz
  sha256: 92e504371869091fe1ef1dd5a1f2996aa369ed9db6c7d2a56650231786ac7c5d

build:
  # Prioritize nompi via build number
  number: ${{ 1 + (100 if mpi == "nompi" else 0) }}
  skip:
    - osx and arm64 and mpi == "openmpi"
    - win
  string: mpi_${{ mpi }}_h${{ hash }}_${{ build_number }}

requirements:
  build:
    - ${{ compiler("c") }}
    - ${{ compiler("cxx") }}
    - make
  host:
    - if: mpi != "nompi"
      then: ${{ mpi }}
    - fftw
    - gsl
    - libblas
    - libfabric
    - liblapack
    - "libopenblas * *openmp*"
    - zlib
  run:
    - if: mpi != "nompi"
      then: ${{ mpi }}
    - gawk
    - "libopenblas * *openmp*"


tests:
  - package_contents:
      lib:
        - ${{ name }}
        - ${{ name }}Kernel
        - lib${{ name }}Wrapper.a
  - script:
      - if: target_platform == build_platform
        then:
          - if: mpi == "openmpi"
            then:
              - export OMPI_MCA_plm=isolated
              - export OMPI_MCA_btl_vader_single_copy_mechanism=none
              - export OMPI_MCA_rmaps_base_oversubscribe=yes
              - export OMPI_MCA_btl=vader,self
          - plumed info --root
          - plumed info --long-version
          - plumed-patch -h
          - plumed config has external_blas external_lapack fftw gsl zlib
          - if: mpi != "nompi"
            then:
              - plumed config has mpi
          - if: not (target_platform == "linux-ppc64le"
                     or target_platform == "linux-aarch64"
                     or target_platform == "osx-arm64")
            then:
              - plumed config has asmjit
          - $PREFIX/lib/plumed/plumed-runtime -h

about:
  homepage: http://www.plumed.org/
  license: LGPL-3.0-only
  license_file: COPYING.LESSER
  summary: Free energy calculations in molecular systems
  description: |
    PLUMED is an open source library for free energy calculations in
    molecular systems which works together with some of the most
    popular molecular dynamics engines.
  documentation: https://www.plumed.org/doc
  repository: https://github.com/plumed/plumed2

extra:
  recipe-maintainers:
    - GiovanniBussi
    - mkrack
